_purpose: SYNTHETIC-ONLY fixtures for the B1.4b synthetic harness. No real words, no real norms, no dataset. Toy synthetic operators/targets exercise pipeline mechanics + terminal-label logic. Nothing here is evidence.

cases.name: pipeline_interaction_signal
cases._note: POSITIVE CONTROL: Y planted from F-3 non-commutativity feature; pipeline must detect it.

cases.name: pipeline_phonology_collapses_f3
cases._note: Y planted from pooled phonological features; phonology (primary) must win, F-3 must NOT false-positive.

cases.name: pipeline_bag_order_insensitive
cases._note: Y = count(unit0) - count(unit1) of two phonological-twin units (identical phonology, distinct identity); pooled phonology is structurally blind to it while the unit histogram (bag) predicts it. Order-insensitive.

cases.name: scores_sentiment_baseline_explains
cases._note: Injected scores: a concept-level sentiment covariate (not reducible to the varṇa bag) explains Y while F-3 does not. Driven at the decision layer because pooled-phonology/bag span any per-unit-mean in the synthetic setup.

cases.name: pipeline_pure_null
cases._note: Y is pure noise; every method at chance -> bottom.

cases.name: pipeline_decoder_gloss_leak_invalid
cases._note: Even with a planted interaction signal, a gloss leak into the decoder invalidates the run.

cases.name: pipeline_word_leak_invalid
cases._note: Generator saw the target word -> invalid regardless of scores.

cases.name: pipeline_y_not_independent
cases._note: Y not independently sourced -> gate trips before scoring is trusted.

cases.name: scores_random_relabel_explains
cases._note: Random operator relabeling ties F-3 -> the true operator->unit assignment carries no special signal.

cases.name: scores_inconclusive_borderline
cases._note: F-3 leads but does not beat the runner-up by the required margin, and the runner-up is itself in the gray zone (below strong), so no baseline credibly explains -> ambiguous.

cases.name: scores_signal_clean
cases._note: Decision-logic check: F-3 beats every baseline by margin and none explains.

cases.name: scores_phonology_ties_f3
cases._note: Decision-logic check: phonology within margin of F-3 -> collapse (primary control).
